findings.title: Public product/run factory cwd is never consumed as the submitted run default
findings.trigger: Normal public SDK factory options set cwd differing from launcher cwd, and later submit supplies objective without repeating cwd. No actual invocation performed.
findings.contract: Explicit ProductRuntimeOptions.cwd and CreateRunManagerOptions.cwd working directory comments with process.cwd fallback imply honoring a specified directory.
findings.actual: Both factories omit cwd entirely; manager has no defaultCwd slot and submit uses input.cwd ?? process.cwd; EngineRunner forwards snapshot cwd.
findings.impact: Wrong configured default cwd in run snapshot/downstream configuration only; no tool, model, filesystem or security impact executed/claimed.
findings.validation: Static complete source dataflow only; 0 product imports, constructor calls or tests.

note: Static public API config omission, no dynamic product construction or downstream operation claim.
